title: Smoothness at generic points of geometrically reduced fibres
statement: Let $p:Z\to S$ be a flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] morphism of Noetherian schemes (quasi-compact schemes locally the spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]). Suppose all geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] are reduced, meaning their local rings have no nonzero nilpotents. If $s\in S$ and $z\in Z_s=Z\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ is the generic point of an irreducible component of that fibre [def-weil-irreducible-components, def-sc-generic-point], then $p$ is smooth at the image of $z$ in $Z$: that point has an open neighbourhood $W$ for which $p|_W$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms].
